blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Motorists will pay less for fuel as another wave of pump price rollbacks hits this week, with one of the major oil firms implementing a drop of up to P5.80 per liter. On Monday, Seaoil said in a statement that diesel prices would decline by P3.80 per liter starting Tuesday. READ: Oil price cuts may extend next week Gasoline will likewise decrease by P1.50 per liter. Kerosene will see the biggest drop, down P5.80 per liter.
